vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: openclaw-money-course
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle consists solely of informational Markdown instructions and metadata for an educational course on monetizing OpenClaw. It contains no executable code, external dependencies, or suspicious prompt-injection instructions, and its behavior is entirely consistent with its stated purpose (SKILL.md).

llm.summary: Instruction-only monetization coach that asks no credentials, installs nothing, and stays consistent with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name/description (help users monetize OpenClaw skills to earn a first ¥99) matches the SKILL.md content. It requires no binaries, env vars, or installs, which is appropriate for a guidance-only skill. Success-case revenue claims in the doc are unverifiable but not a security mismatch.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only conversational guidance steps (assess skills, recommend paths, action plans, templates). It does not instruct the agent to read files, access system env vars, or transmit user data to external endpoints. It may suggest external resource links, which is expected for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — lowest-risk instruction-only skill. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables, credentials, or config paths are declared or referenced. The skill does not request any secrets, which is proportionate to a guidance-only capability.
dimensions.label: Credentials

dimensions.detail: always:false (not force-included). disable-model-invocation:false (agent may invoke autonomously), which is the platform default. This autonomy is not combined with any other risky flags, so it does not raise additional concern.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only monetization advisor and appears internally consistent: it asks for no secrets and installs nothing. Before using: (1) verify any external resource links the agent provides before clicking, (2) do not paste private credentials or sensitive data into the chat, (3) treat revenue claims and pricing suggestions as estimates — validate them against real market data, and (4) review any recommended messaging/templates to ensure they don't expose personal or client data. Because the skill can be invoked autonomously by the agent (the platform default), monitor initial runs to confirm its outputs and behavior meet your expectations.
